evidence.reason: prepare_run persists free_port() into the run record before launch. free_port only establishes that a port is momentarily available; it cannot reserve the port for QEMU, so another prepare or process can claim it before boot binds. The saved port can then collide at launch and boot has no supplied collision retry. Selecting the forwarding port at launch under the launch lock, retrying bind collisions, and persisting the successfully used port is a narrow ordinary correctness fix, not a new requirement or owner decision.
